big.fact: Longest COP ever · first collapse since 2009
big.headline: COP31 COLLAPSES: NO DEAL AT ALL
big.summary: After 44 hours of overtime, the EU and others reject a pact that never names fossil fuels. President Kurum gavels it dead.

big.fact: 2 wounded in Sitra fire · US denies military damage
big.headline: IRAN CLAIMS STRIKES ON US BASES IN BAHRAIN
big.summary: IRGC claims missiles hit US Patriot radars in Bahrain; the US and Bahrain deny military damage. Two hurt in a civilian-site fire in Sitra.

big.headline: ALCARAZ DETHRONES ZVEREV IN TURIN
big.summary: Carlos Alcaraz beats world No. 1 Alexander Zverev 6-2, 7-6(7), saving three set points to win his first ATP Finals crown.
